diagnosis: Private networking is not offered in ap-south per kb-0008; requests in unsupported regions stay queued instead of failing, which matches the customer's report of 'nothing happened'. Additionally, kb-0010 indicates private networking requires the premium support tier, while this account is on the standard support tier and lists no such entitlement, so access would be blocked even in a supported region.
reply:
Thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the confusing experience.

Private networking is not currently available in ap-south. It is only offered in us-east, us-west and eu-west. In regions where it is not yet supported, requests are held in a queued state rather than returning an error, which is likely why enabling it appeared to do nothing on your side.

There is a second factor worth flagging: private networking is also gated to the premium support tier, and your account is on the standard support tier, so this capability is not included in your current plan regardless of region.

At this time we are not able to enable private networking for your account in ap-south. If your architecture requires private connectivity, the practical options are to deploy the relevant resources in one of the supported regions (us-east, us-west or eu-west), or to revisit this if your plan tier changes. We are happy to help you evaluate either path.
